# Om Muruga Travels & Holidays

> Premier travel agency and tour operator in South India under Group of Gowda's. We provide customized holiday tour packages, private AC outstation cab services, airport/railway transfers, and handpicked boutique cottage stays in Kodaikanal, Ooty, Munnar, Rameswaram, and beyond.

## Core Services

- [Custom Holiday Tour Packages](https://ommurugatravels.com/tours): Handcrafted travel circuits covering Hill Stations, Spiritual Temples, Honeymoon getaways, and Family retreats.
- [Private AC Cabs & Transportation Fleet](https://ommurugatravels.com/tours#fleet): Clean, sanitized sedan cabs (Dzire / Etios), premium MUVs (Innova Crysta), and 17-seater Tempo Travelers driven by mountain-certified chauffeurs.
- [Boutique Hill Stays & Cottages](https://ommurugatravels.com/rooms): Handcrafted bamboo luxury cottages, treehouse chalets, and private estates in Kodaikanal.
- [Contact & 24/7 Travel Desk](https://ommurugatravels.com/contact): Direct assistance, immediate booking confirmations, and custom itinerary blueprints.

## Key Destinations
- Kodaikanal (Pine Forests, Pillar Rocks, Kodai Lake, Berijam)
- Munnar (Tea Terraces, Gap Road, Eravikulam, Mattupetty)
- Ooty & Coonoor (Nilgiri Mountain Railway, Botanical Gardens, Doddabetta)
- Rameswaram & Dhanushkodi (Ramanathaswamy Temple, Pamban Bridge)
- Madurai, Coorg, Wayanad, and custom South India routes
